title: MoEFCC celebrates ‘Har Ghar Tiranga 2026’ campaign with mass singing of National Song ‘Vande Mataram’
body_text:
As part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ Campaign and the commemoration of 150 years of the National Song ‘Vande Mataram’, officers and officials of the Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, led by Secretary, Shri Tanmay Kumar, today participated in a mass singing of the National Song at Indira Paryavaran Bhawan (IPB), New Delhi.
The mass singing was followed by a tree plantation activity led by the Secretary, reaffirming the Ministry’s commitment to environmental conservation and sustainable development. Offices under the administrative control of the Ministry across the country are actively participating in the Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 campaign and collective singing of the National Song, besides carrying out plantation drives. Also, the Ministry is encouraging officers and employees to upload ‘Selfie with Tiranga’ on the Har Ghar Tiranga Portal (www.harghartiranga.com).
The spirit of our National Song #VandeMataram echoed through Indira Paryavaran Bhawan! MoEFCC officers and officials, led by Secretary ( @MOEFCC ), Shri Tanmay Kumar, came together for a mass singing, celebrating 150 years of the National Song. As part of #HarGharTiranga2026 … pic.twitter.com/AwV2o1P4sn — MoEF&CC (@moefcc) August 14, 2026
The Government of India has decided to celebrate ‘Har Ghar Tiranga 2026’, across the country from 9th to 17th August, 2026, in conjunction with commemoration of 150 years of the National Song ‘Vande Mataram’.

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

enrichment.summary: On 14 August 2026, MoEFCC officials, led by Secretary Tanmay Kumar, participated in a mass singing of the National Song 'Vande Mataram' at Indira Paryavaran Bhawan, New Delhi, as part of the 'Har Ghar Tiranga 2026' campaign and the 150th anniversary commemoration of the song. This was followed by a tree plantation drive. The Ministry is also encouraging employees to upload selfies with the Tricolour on the Har Ghar Tiranga portal.
enrichment.context: Har Ghar Tiranga is a Government of India initiative under the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav framework, encouraging citizens to hoist the national flag at their homes to foster patriotism, typically observed around Independence Day. In 2026, the campaign coincided with the 150th anniversary of 'Vande Mataram', composed by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay in 1875 (first published in Anandamath in 1882), which was adopted as the National Song and played a significant role in the Indian freedom movement. This event is a routine departmental participation in a symbolic national commemoration and carries no new policy announcement.
